app.name: Gekko2
app.long_description: Gekko2 early alpha. R1342 Beta adds bounded EE reuse, CPU service guards and IOP deadlines. Experimental ARM BIOS RAM jobs require MLOAD and default OFF. Supply your own BIOS in sd:/pcsx2/bios/. PLUS pauses; MINUS + A sends PS2 START. HOME returns to the launcher; HOME + MINUS exits to the Homebrew Channel. Physical Wii speedup and playable PS2 games are not established.
